resolution.note: base-red proof runs the contract's Python runner; real python3 unittest receiver covers red, green, import error

title: a defect ship accepts a Python regression test as base-red proof
body:
Evidence 2026-11-18 (Astra gap map, .krn/runs/research/daily-2026-11-18/astra-full.md §2 item 3): baseRedProof in src/ci/base-red.ts filters test files to JS/TS extensions, so a defect fix in an adopted Python repo (src/adopt/skeleton/python/) is refused as no-test; probe baseRedProof('.', 'main', git) on a diff adding tests/test_receiver.py returns kind no-test.
Outcome: krn pr ship in a Python repo accepts the fix when the same test fails on an assertion at base and passes at HEAD; a green base and an import error get distinct refusal reasons.
Proof: a receiver test runs the adopter contract's real runner in a small Python project through ship's entry for all three runs.
Files: src/ci/base-red.ts, src/repo/contract.ts, src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
